page_title: VEN 2-2 COM | Venezia v Como 08/12/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+3' Domen Crnigoj (Venezia) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked.
90+1' Celebrations are cut short for Venezia as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review shows it was offside!
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
89' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was an offside in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The Venezia players aren’t happy.

88' The ball rebounds and arrives at the feet of Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Venezia) just outside the box. He doesn't think twice and fires a brilliant shot inside the left post. His attempt was beyond the reach of Pepe Reina, so the score changes to 3:2.
85' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Simone Verdi (Como) will replace Lucas Da Cunha.
85' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Alessandro Gabrielloni (Como) replaces Gabriel Strefezza.
84' Marc Oliver Kempf (Como) makes a rough challenge and Daniele Doveri blows his whistle for a foul. Venezia have a free kick.
84' Eusebio Di Francesco prepares a substitution. Gaetano Oristanio is replaced by John Yeboah (Venezia).
84' That will be all from Gianluca Busio who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Domen Crnigoj (Venezia).
82' 5:9 – the corner kicks stats.
78' Neat passing move from Como in order to create new attacking opportunities.
76' Here is a change. Marco Sala is going off and Cesc Fabregas gives the last tactical orders to Alessio Iovine (Como).
76' That's the end of the game for Andrea Belotti, who is replaced by Patrick Cutrone (Como).
76' Marco Sala (Como) is shown a yellow card by the referee.
74' Como fail to score from a corner as Filip Stankovic (Venezia) leaps to collect the ball.
69' 2 - 2 Unbelievable! Gaetano Oristanio (Venezia) scores direct from the corner. He curls the ball and it goes straight into the back of the net. 2:2.
69' Gaetano Oristanio (Venezia) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
69' The referee blows his whistle, Venezia are awarded a corner kick.

67' Ignace Van der Brempt (Como) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent. Venezia are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
67' Cesc Fabregas has decided to make a change. Luca Mazzitelli (Como) replaces Alieu Fadera.
64' Alieu Fadera (Como) tries to put the rebound into the net from the edge of the box, but the goalkeeper pulls off a good save to deny him.
64' A substitution has been made. Issa Doumbia goes off and Magnus Kofod Andersen (Venezia) comes on.
64' Eusebio Di Francesco decides to make a substitution. Antonio Candela will be replaced by Mikael Egill Ellertsson (Venezia).
64' The referee allows time for a substitution. Giorgio Altare will be replaced by Marin Sverko (Venezia).
59' Nico Paz (Como) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box and produces a poor effort that sails miles wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Venezia.
56' 1 - 2 Fantastic team goal! Andrea Belotti (Como) was set free in the area by Ignace Van der Brempt and he made no mistake with a lovely finish into the bottom left corner. 1:2.
55' Venezia win a corner.
55' Venezia failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat. Now Venezia have a corner.

52' Francesco Zampano (Venezia) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The referee points to the corner flag and Venezia will take a corner.
51' Cesc Fabregas isn't happy on the touchline after referee Daniele Doveri shows him a yellow card.
50' 1 - 1 Here is an example of luck not being on your side. Antonio Candela (Venezia) unluckily turns a cross into his own net.
49' Antonio Candela (Venezia) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
47' Antonio Candela (Venezia) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The ball is out of play. Venezia will have a throw-in.
46' The second half has just started.
45+1' Daniele Doveri blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
44' Daniele Doveri blows his whistle as Gabriel Strefezza (Como) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
43' The current number of corner kicks is 0:8.
41' Como force a corner. They send men into the box.
41' Giorgio Altare (Venezia) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
39' Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Venezia) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Daniele Doveri didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
34' None of the Como players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and Venezia will have a goal kick.
34' Alieu Fadera (Como) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away. The linesman makes the right call and Como will have a corner.
33' Como have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
32' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Como. Como will take a corner kick.
32' Como can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
31' Alieu Fadera (Como) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender. Como get a corner.
28' Como control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
24' Como quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
24' A pass by Marco Sala (Como) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Venezia.
20' Daniele Doveri blows for a foul after Francesco Zampano (Venezia) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. Como have a free kick.
18' Daniele Doveri sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
18' Wait! Referee Daniele Doveri has indicated he is going to review the Venezia goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
16' 1 - 0 Goal! Francesco Zampano takes aim and his effort deflects off Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Venezia) to beat the goalkeeper. 1:0.
12' Edoardo Goldaniga (Como) commits a rough challenge and Daniele Doveri blows his whistle for an infringement. Venezia will take a free kick.
11' Ignace Van der Brempt (Como) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
10' The referee signals a corner kick to Como.
7' Como are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
4' Como take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

3' Gabriel Strefezza (Como) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and fires a nice strike from a promising distance towards the roof of the net. Filip Stankovic has a clear sight of it and makes a comfortable save.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are on the pitch and Venezia will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Daniele Doveri.
